covered_definition: Valid returned T60 sportsbook MARKET benchmark, not proof any game lacked real-world bookmaker availability
schedule_universe_note: Canonical schedule context may include games absent from identical saved model prediction cohort; all overlap comparisons use only matched saved-model cohort. Team tables count appearances, not independent games.
limitations: No real-model fitting, inference, native loading or network
Empirical coverage fractions are sample summaries, not a treatment assignment model
Overlap changes target population and does not recover missing sportsbook prices
Selection on unobserved team strength, genuine game importance, source mechanism or market conditions remains unidentified
Intervals descriptive, development-exposed, no multiplicity adjustment and no proof of market advantage
Provider conference tags not authoritative historical membership; neutral native context not independently verified venue
Empirical weights do not establish conditional exchangeability or causal effects
